name: clear-fit-portal-modernization
text: The Department of Veterans Affairs seeks a contractor to replace the legacy Benefits Intake system with a cloud-native web application. The contractor shall deliver a citizen-facing portal meeting WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, integrate with the existing claims database through REST APIs, and migrate roughly 4 million historical records. Period of performance is 18 months. Proposals are due March 15, 2030 at 5:00 PM Eastern. This acquisition is not set aside. No security clearance is required; a public trust background check applies to all personnel.

name: hardware-reseller
note: SYNTHETIC. Pure hardware buy, should be skip.
text: The Government requires the purchase and delivery of 300 laptop computers, each with 16 GB RAM, 512 GB solid state storage, and a three-year manufacturer warranty. Brand name or equal. Delivery to the Kansas City warehouse within 45 days of award. This is a firm fixed price purchase of commercial off-the-shelf equipment. Offers are due February 1, 2030.

name: clearance-required
note: SYNTHETIC. Software work, but a TS/SCI clearance is mandatory; should not be pursue.
text: The contractor shall provide software development and sustainment for classified mission systems. All personnel must hold an active TS/SCI clearance with polygraph at the time of proposal submission. Work will be performed on-site in a SCIF at Fort Meade. The system is written primarily in Ada and C++. Proposals are due April 2, 2030.

name: unstated-deadline-trap
note: SYNTHETIC. No deadline appears in the text; the model should answer null, not invent one.
text: The Department of Justice intends to replace its legacy case management system with a modern, configurable web-based platform. The platform shall support document intake, automated routing, role-based access, and reporting dashboards. A formal solicitation will be posted at a later date; interested vendors should monitor this notice. Anticipated period of performance is two years with three option years.
